en.eg_lead: How Kolaboro is built, tested and kept honest: what shipped on 23 Nov 2026, and the engineering pages, which are in English.
en.yc_lead: The problem, the data and what we ship. Figures load live from our published data. The full page, with weekly traction and every shipped list, is in English.
en.yc_pb: People buying property off-plan abroad pay deposits for buildings that do not exist yet, in a country whose registers, language and law they do not know. Developer pages are marketing; the facts that matter (permit, company, handover date record, deposit protection) are scattered across official registers.
en.yc_do: For every off-plan project we track, a public page with what the developer promises, what official registers and independent sources show, and what we could not verify, each fact with its source and date. Buyers who want certainty pay for a check (from 490 euros) or monthly construction monitoring (99 euros a month). Developers never pay us.

en.yc_tr: Traction, as counted (weekly visits, leads and paid checks, zeros included) is on the English page and on /metrics/.
en.dp_h1: Honest developers sell faster to buyers abroad.
en.dp_lead: Buyers abroad can't tell you apart from the developers who never build. A verified Kolaboro Trust Score lets them.
en.dp_s1: You share your land title, permits, contract template and company documents.
en.dp_s2: We check them against the official registry. Site visits by a local agent are on request: we confirm a local agent for your location before you pay.
en.dp_s3: You see the findings and have 10 working days to respond or add evidence.
en.dp_s4: Your project page goes live with its Trust Score and your reply.
en.dp_s5: We re-check every 90 days while you build, so your Score keeps up with your progress.
en.dp_cost: Developers never pay Kolaboro. Buyers fund every check. That's why a good result from us means something.
en.dp_bd: If every project of yours that we track makes all 6 buyer checks public (permit, deposit protection, progress, plans, track record, no guaranteed returns), you can show a free badge that links to your developer page on Kolaboro. It is issued from the public data and cannot be bought.

en.vf_sum: Today our {p} project records hold {n} key facts with a source. {c} of them ({cp}) are confirmed in an official register or by our satellite reading; {r} records hold at least one value from an official register.
en.vf_st1: We read a fact where it is published: an official register, the developer's own site, a listing portal or another public page. We keep the value as written, with the link and the date we read it.
en.vf_st2: We grade a fact by its source, not by opinion. A value from an official register or our own satellite reading counts as confirmed. A value that only the developer, a portal or another page publishes counts as published, not confirmed.
en.vf_st3: A fact we cannot find stays empty. We never estimate it: the record says what to ask the developer for and which official register can confirm it.
en.vf_st4: Every day we keep a copy of every record, chained by SHA-256 hashes. A change is counted only when a value moves, not when the same fact is restated more precisely.
en.vf_st5: A fact read more than 180 days ago is marked "re-check due" on its record until we read it again.
en.vf_st6: Anyone can report an error, and corrections are published with their date. These are facts with their sources, not a verdict about any project or developer.
en.vf_k_p: Each fact carries the kind of its source. Only official registers and our satellite reading count as confirmed.

en.n40k707_s: The ? key now opens the keyboard shortcuts overlay on every page, in 8 languages; before, it left the page for the shortcuts page.
en.n40k803_t: Six ready comparisons on the compare page
en.n40k803_s: The compare page now opens with six ready pairs in Gold Coast, Dubai, Miami, Phuket and Costa del Sol: handover on record, permit number and price from in one table, no typing needed.
en.n40k804_t: A later whole year now counts as a moved handover
en.n40k804_s: When a project's handover moves from one whole year to a later one (2027 to 2028), project, developer and compare pages now show the later date and mark it as moved.
en.n40k805_t: Place, handover and permit under every project title
en.n40k805_s: Project pages now show the place, the handover date on record (marked when it moved) and whether a permit number is published right under the title, on the first phone screen, in all 8 languages.
en.n40k806_t: Plain wording on case cards and the listing box
en.n40k806_s: Case cards now say Developer promises read, and the free listing check box on partner sites describes the check in plain terms, in all 8 languages.
en.dv_p_1: {n} project of {d} has a field-by-field record. For each key fact: whether it is held, and whether the value comes from an official register.
en.dr_m_1: {g} of {h} facts from a register, {n} project
en.lt_p41: Paste a project name or its link. Your browser matches it against our public index; what you type is not sent anywhere.
en.lt_er41: The index could not be loaded. Please try again in a minute.
en.lt_nf41: Not in our index. We may not track this project yet: try the developer name or the project website.
en.lt_mx41: Showing 8. Type more of the name to narrow it down.
en.lt_mv41: Moved: first published as {d}, a later date is now on record.
en.lt_mvn41: Handover date moves in our daily copies: {n}
en.lt_late41: Late: the handover date on record passed {m} months ago and the project is not recorded as completed.

en.lt_okmv41: Not past the date on record, but the handover date has already moved later.
en.lt_ok41: Not late so far: the handover date on record has not passed.
en.lt_unk41: No handover date on record, so we cannot say.
en.lt_nrg41: Official register: no entry recorded by us.

en.n40k901_s: Developer and market suggestions in the search box and the map count say 1 project instead of 1 projects, in 8 languages.
en.n40k902_t: Market names in the page language
en.n40k902_s: Headings of the market dashboard, record facts, areas and next handovers use the local market name (Dubai becomes دبي, Дубай, 迪拜) in Arabic, Russian, Chinese and the other languages.
en.n40k903_t: Past-handover counts say what they count
en.n40k903_s: On market pages the summary line counts dates passed with no completion on record, and the dashboard tile counts every ended handover period, completed ones included, so the two figures no longer read as a contradiction.
en.n40k904_s: Neighbourhood and group pages labelled the median transparency score as median months past; the tile now says Median transparency score, in 8 languages.
en.n40k905_t: Headings in order on tools and pricing
en.n40k905_s: The tools hub and the pricing page now go h1, h2, h3 in every language, so screen readers and search engines read the groups and plans in order.
en.n40k1001_t: Data catalog page four times lighter
en.n40k1001_s: The open data catalog page went from 749 KB to 190 KB: the files not yet described load on demand, 50 per page.
en.n40k1002_s: Project, developer and market pages now share one cached style file instead of 25 KB of inline styles on every page; they look exactly the same.
en.n40k1003_t: Reduced motion also stops scripted scrolling
en.n40k1003_s: With reduced motion set on your device, every scripted scroll on the site (back to top, table of contents, search focus) now jumps instead of gliding.
en.d40_ps_1: {a} of {n} projects publishes a permit or registration number
en.d40_rs_1: {a} of {n} projects found in an official register
en.n40k1201_t: Use this project in a buyer tool
en.n40k1201_s: Project pages link to six buyer tools (late handover, delay compensation, resale, deposit protection, rental yield, currency risk) that open filled from the project's public record: price, currency, handover date and market. Delay compensation, resale, yield and currency tools now also keep every input in the address, so a shared link restores the result.
en.n40k1202_t: Ranking method box in the page language
en.n40k1202_s: Translated rankings pages showed the method box twice, once in English; they now show it once, in the page language, in 7 languages.
en.n40k1101_s: Developer, market and country pages now say "1 project" and "1 market" instead of "1 projects", in all 8 languages.
en.n40k1102_t: Six checks show a moved date
en.n40k1102_s: When a later handover date is on record, the six-check light on a project now says "date moved" in amber instead of "date kept so far".
en.n40k1103_s: The project X-ray, the contract check and project pages now say "no hosted model was called" and "runs in your browser".
en.n40k1104_s: Paste a project name or link on the home page or /check/: handover date on record, moves, months past and register entry, matched in your browser.
en.n40k1105_t: Charts you can read as text
en.n40k1105_s: Each delay strip now reads its numbers aloud (sample, median, middle half, range), and the Bali map has a table with the same counts.
en.n40k1106_t: Market pages link the country guides
en.n40k1106_s: Translated market pages now link the country overview and how-to-check guide of their country in the same language.
en.ch_p: The 20 countries where we track the most projects. Each page lists the projects, the official registers and how to check a developer.
en.n40k1301_s: A switch on the map shows square pins for projects with at least one key fact read in an official register and round pins for the rest; clusters show the share, with a legend and the same label in the list, in 8 languages.
en.n40k1302_s: On developer pages in Arabic, the first and last dates under the track record chart are no longer cut off at the chart edges.
en.n40k1303_s: Glossary examples quoted from Russian-language sources are now marked as Russian, so screen readers and translators read them correctly, in 8 languages.
en.n40k1304_s: The home page now links the 20 countries where we track the most projects as plain text links, plus all countries, in 8 languages.
en.n40k1305_s: The permits section of every project page is now headed with the question buyers search for, for example: Does this project have a permit or licence?, in 8 languages.
en.n40k1306_t: Total cost filled from a project
en.n40k1306_s: Project pages open the total cost calculator with the project's country, price and currency filled from its public record, and every input stays in the address so a shared link restores the result.
en.n40k1401_t: Plural forms in Arabic and Russian
en.n40k1401_s: Counts of projects, markets, developers, sources, photos and countries take the form the number needs in Arabic and Russian (two, few, many), with one shared rule for every page.
en.n40k1402_s: Saint Lucia was recorded under two spellings with two market pages; its two projects now share /m/saint-lucia/, the old address redirects there and the data files count it once.
en.n40k1403_s: Translated tool pages, the registers guide and the monthly satellite page are kept ready at the edge and no longer read the full project file to build their links, so parallel visits no longer fail.
en.n40k1404_t: Payment risk filled from a project
en.n40k1404_s: Project pages open the payment risk tool with the price and handover date from the public record, and every input stays in the address so a shared link restores the result.
en.n40k1501_s: Translated pages and the check page load their interface strings and form code from cached files, so a translated page is 15 to 75 KB lighter (the Spanish check page went from 119 to 45 KB).
en.n40k1502_s: Place descriptions in the Turkey country guide (for example near the airport, Asian side) now show in the page language; wording we have no translation for is marked as English for screen readers.
en.n40k1503_s: Even spacing between the introduction, the links and the live figures, and tile borders that follow the dark theme.
en.n40k1601_t: Market titles that carry the figures
en.n40k1601_s: 80 market files (the first 8 alphabetical batches) now state the project count with the permit share or the main handover year in the title, and permits, overdue handovers and developers in the description, in 8 languages; before and after are logged in /data/ctr-changes.tsv.
en.n40k1602_t: Payment plan check filled from a project
en.n40k1602_s: Project pages link the payment plan check with the project: it sets the handover payment to the date on the public record, and the whole plan stays in the address so a shared link restores it, in 8 languages.
en.n40k1603_s: The script that puts place names, dates and numbers in the page language is now one cached file instead of inline on every translated page (about 5 KB less HTML each), and the map page styles moved to a cached stylesheet.
en.n40k1604_s: A check before every push reads every static page and one page per worker template in 8 languages, and fails when a page is given as its own alternate in another language or a canonical or alternate points to a missing page.
en.n40k1801_t: Delay counts explained side by side
en.n40k1801_s: The most delayed ranking and the press figures by place now say how each counts late projects (first date on record against the date published now) and link to each other, so their numbers no longer read as a contradiction.
en.n40k1802_t: Oman register card follows the 2025 law
en.n40k1802_s: The Oman card on the register guide and the Oman country page now cite the Real Estate Regulation Law (Royal Decree No. 79/2025, in force from March 2026), which repealed the 2018 escrow system, with the date we read the texts; a sentence we could no longer source was removed.
en.n40k1803_t: Screen reader fixes on developer and home pages
en.n40k1803_s: The developer timeline link on every developer page now has a name, the payment card icons are announced as one labelled image and the decorative ticks on the home page are hidden from screen readers, in 8 languages.
en.n40d601_t: New type and colour across the site
en.n40d601_s: Headings now use Source Serif 4 and text uses IBM Plex Sans, self-hosted and preloaded, with IBM Plex Sans Arabic on Arabic pages and tabular figures for every number.
en.n40d602_t: Calmer pages in light and dark
en.n40d602_s: White sheets on a cool paper background, one cobalt colour for buttons, links and focus, a quiet top strip and header, and a deep ink dark mode, all checked for contrast.
en.n40d603_s: The first screen has a larger headline and a single search bar, and the key numbers sit on a dark band right below it with large figures.
en.n40k2001_s: The last 26 market files (Panama City to Zanzibar) now state the project count with the permit share or the main handover year in the title, and permits, overdue handovers and developers in the description, in 8 languages; before and after are logged in /data/ctr-changes.tsv.
en.n40k2002_t: Translated new-project pages turn the page
en.n40k2002_s: /fr/new/?p=2 and the other translated new-project and comparison lists now show the page asked for, with their own address, and their page links stay in the page language, in 8 languages.
en.n40k2003_t: Translated pages link to translated pages
en.n40k2003_s: Links on translated pages now go to the translated version of the press figures by place, the methods, the engineering pages and 100 more pages wherever one exists, instead of the English page, in 8 languages.
en.n40k2004_t: Dubai's overdue count says what it counts
en.n40k2004_s: The Dubai market description now says its 12 are projects not completed whose published handover date has passed, the definition used by the press figures, and the same wording applies to every English market title test.
en.n40k2005_s: The prefetch rules in every page are shorter (one rule for file links, project pages matched by address), so the tools hub, the glossary and every other page carry about 0.5 KB less HTML, in 8 languages.
en.n40k2006_s: The market page script no longer replaces the title and description the server writes for /m/, so browsers and search engines see the same figures in the title.
en.n40k2101_t: Pages stay up under heavy traffic
en.n40k2101_s: When many visitors arrive at once, each data file is now read and unpacked once and shared, and a file read that fails is tried again, so pages no longer fail with a server error under load.
en.n40k2102_t: A clear retry notice instead of a bare error
en.n40k2102_s: If a page still cannot be built, visitors get a short notice in their language with a Try again link and a Retry-After header, styled even when nothing else has loaded.
en.n40k2201_t: Delay index on the full project set
en.n40k2201_s: The delay index and on-time odds now cover all 4,613 tracked projects, and the recompute in your browser matches every published figure again.
en.n40k2202_t: Automated checks and safeguards, in plain terms
en.n40k2202_s: How the desk review resists hidden instructions on developer websites: hidden text removed, page treated as data, fixed patterns, a strict answer format, two independent readings and daily tests.
en.n40k2203_t: Plainer dataset names in the open data catalog
en.n40k2203_s: Dataset titles and descriptions on /data/ now say what each file holds and how it is checked.
en.b_x_h_1: {m}: {n} project due in the next 12 months
en.n40k2301_t: Build cost check from a project page
en.n40k2301_s: The build cost tool now opens with the market, starting price and currency of the project you came from, and the address keeps every input, so a shared link shows the same result.
en.n40k2302_s: The list of projects due in the next 12 months now reads "1 project" instead of "1 projects" on market pages, in 8 languages.
en.n40d701_t: A shorter home page with a real example
en.n40d701_s: The home page now has one search box with suggestions as you type, a real project's six checks with the date we checked them in place of an illustrated example, and 9 sections instead of 20, so it is about a third shorter on phones.
en.n40d702_t: Project pages open with a summary card
en.n40d702_s: At the top of every project page: the name, badges for place, handover date and permit, the answer in one line, and the six checks beside it while you scroll. The key facts and the official register sit side by side, and every section below is its own card.
en.n40k2501_t: Five more tools open from a project page
en.n40k2501_s: The on-time check, residence by investment, inheritance tax, foreign mortgages and market report tools now fill in what the public record holds for the project you came from (market, promised handover date, starting price, country), say what was filled, and keep the inputs in the address so a shared link shows the same result.
en.n40k2502_t: Refund tracker from a project page
en.n40k2502_s: The refund tracker fills the developer, project and currency from the project you came from. The unsaved form is kept after the # in the address, which is never sent to a server, so a saved link restores it.
en.n40k2503_t: Projects by stage and handover year
en.n40k2503_s: Each developer page now shows its projects by the year of the handover date on record and by stage, as a bar chart with the same counts in a table.
en.n40k2401_t: One count per definition on every page
en.n40k2401_s: Market files in 8 languages, their descriptions, the slippage block, the press figures and the most delayed ranking now read the same file: past the first handover date on record, or not completed and past the currently published date, each labelled.
en.n40k2402_s: A project in Alanya was filed under Antalya. It now counts in the Alanya market, and the delay index was recomputed.
en.n40k2403_t: French market titles with the right preposition
en.n40k2403_s: French titles and descriptions now say en Pologne, au Portugal, aux Philippines and à Zanzibar, and French and German descriptions stay within 160 characters.
en.n40k2404_s: The weekly digest and its data feed no longer list Sumba as a market; Sumba appears only in the transparency ranking.
en.n40k2405_s: The monthly press edition is labelled as of 4 November 2026 and links to the current figures.
en.n40k2601_t: Five questions answered on every market page
en.n40k2601_s: Market pages in all 8 languages answer five questions buyers search: how many projects we track, how many publish a permit number, when they are due, how many are past their date and which developers build the most, each answer dated and marked up as an FAQ.
en.n40k2701_t: Past the published handover date, from every dated record
en.n40k2701_s: The delay index now takes the currently published handover month from the best record we hold: the overdue watcher when it has read the project, else the dated handover promise or the handover in the project record, with its source and read date. A project not completed whose month has passed counts as past the published date (Dubai: 39 instead of 12), and every market page, the slippage block, the press figures by place and the browser recompute agree.
en.n40k2702_t: Singular and plural in market titles and descriptions
en.n40k2702_s: Market pages no longer say "from 1 developers": counts of developers, projects and markets in titles, descriptions and answers take the singular or plural their number asks for in every language.
en.n40k2602_s: Five rules of Costa Rica's pre-sale regulation (Decree 42995-MEIC) quoted from the official legal database: MEIC authorisation before a sale is offered, the public list of authorised plans, down payments held in a trust, six releases tied to construction progress and a 100% refund if the developer breaks the contract.
en.n40k2901_s: Four rules of the Cyprus specific performance law for property sales (Law 81(I)/2011 as amended in 2023) quoted from the Official Gazette: a recent land search certificate with every contract, a written declaration when the property is mortgaged, payment into the seller account named in Form A with the lender bound to release the mortgage, and transfer to the buyer free of later charges.
en.n40k2801_t: Download links on the data catalog say which file
en.n40k2801_s: Every Download, First file and schema link on /data/ now carries the dataset name for screen readers, so a list of links read out of context says which file each one opens.
en.n40k2802_s: The federal corporation search of Corporations Canada was shown as not answering; we opened it again on 26 Nov 2026 and it answers, so the Canada pages now say so.
en.n40k2803_s: Four rules of the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act 2016 quoted from India Code: RERA registration before any sale (section 3), 70% of payments in a separate project account (section 4), no more than 10% before a registered agreement (section 13), refund with interest or monthly interest for delay (section 18). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40d8_reg: Key facts from an official register
en.n40d8_late: Projects whose handover date moved later
en.n40d8_od: Past the handover date and not finished
en.n40d8_tl: Handover dates on record, by year.
en.n40d801_t: Search in the header on every page
en.n40d801_s: A search field in the header suggests projects, developers and markets as you type, in 8 languages.
en.n40d802_s: The phone menu opens as a full-height sheet with search at the top, large links, and the language and theme switches; Escape closes it.
en.n40d803_s: Developer pages open with a summary: projects tracked, share of key facts from an official register, handover dates moved later, projects past due, and handover years as a strip.
en.n40d804_s: On Arabic pages the headline font is fetched first and shown only when ready, so headlines no longer rewrap while the page loads.
en.n40k3101_s: Four rules of Law 4,591 of 1964 quoted from Planalto: registration of the development before any sale (article 32), the optional ring-fenced project estate (article 31-A), the 180-day grace period and the remedies after it (article 43-A), and the cap on what a developer may keep when a buyer cancels (article 67-A). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3102_t: Saudi Arabia buyer protection law page
en.n40k3102_s: Four rules of the Law on the Sale and Lease of Off-Plan Real Estate Projects (Royal Decree M/44 of 1445 AH) quoted from the Real Estate General Authority: a licence and an escrow agreement for each project (article 6), one protected escrow account per project (articles 9 and 10), a 20% cap on non-construction spending (article 12) and compensation for late handover (article 20). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3103_t: Canada (British Columbia) buyer protection law page
en.n40k3103_s: Three rules of the British Columbia Real Estate Development Marketing Act quoted from BC Laws: a disclosure statement filed before marketing and given before signing (sections 14 and 15), deposits held in trust by a brokerage, lawyer or notary (section 18), and a 7-day right to cancel (section 21). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3104_s: Two rules quoted from the Senate legal database: the papers a developer must file with the city before selling homes, open to buyers at all times (Law 962 of 2005, article 71), and the 10-year duty of the builder or seller of a new home to cover owners' losses (Law 1796 of 2016, article 8). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3105_s: Four rules on the sale of a building in the future state of completion (Code of Obligations and Contracts, Law 44-00 as amended by Law 107-12) quoted from the Ministry of Justice portal: one month to withdraw from a reservation (article 618-3 quater), capped payment stages (article 618-6), no payment before a contract (articles 618-5 and 618-8) and a completion or refund guarantee (article 618-9). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3201_t: Compare page no longer jumps as it loads
en.n40k3201_s: The currency switch above the six ready comparisons now has its space kept before it appears, so the table no longer moves down while the page loads on a phone (layout shift down from 0.078 to 0.001 in our lab test).
en.n40k3301_t: Page check compares the published source
en.n40k3301_s: Verify this page now hashes the published source of each page, script and stylesheet, read unchanged from the deploy, and lists what the server adds to the HTML on the way to you (nonces, font preloads, the shared stylesheet, language links, prefetch rules, the ticker, the footer). Pages that showed a mismatch now match.
en.n40k3302_s: Area pages are kept as an edge copy and refreshed in the background, so the server no longer rebuilds them on every visit. Lab test on a phone over slow 4G: largest paint under 2.5 seconds.
en.n40k3303_t: Data desk no longer jumps while loading
en.n40k3303_s: The chart list and headline numbers of the data desk are in the page from the start, so the facts below no longer move down when the live data arrives.
en.n40k3304_s: Links on the changelog that share a visible text such as "Example", "Dubai" or "Map" but open different pages now carry a name that says which page they open, so a screen reader list of links makes sense out of context.
en.n40k3401_s: Three rules for new homes in article 79 of Law 45 of 2007 on consumer protection, quoted from the Official Gazette: a delivery date in the promise of sale and a full refund if it is missed, binding advertising and a written building warranty, and the total price with a right to a lower price if the home differs. Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3402_s: Three rules of the Civil and Commercial Code quoted from InfoLEG: insurance against the failure of an off-plan sale, optional since Decree 1017/2024 (articles 2070 and 2071), priority over later attachments with 25% paid (article 1170) and protection in the seller's bankruptcy (article 1171). Read 26 Nov 2026.
en.n40k3305_t: Verify this page is back in every footer
en.n40k3305_s: The footer link that runs the page check in your browser had disappeared with the new footer; it is back on every page, labelled in the page language.
en.n40k3306_t: Visible keyboard focus on the home page figures
en.n40k3306_s: The four headline figures on the home page now show a clear focus ring when reached with the keyboard, in every language.

es.r_lead: Los 10 datos que un comprador comprueba primero, cada uno con su fuente y la fecha en que lo leímos; lo que aún no sabemos y cómo averiguarlo; y cómo se compara esta ficha con su mercado.
es.r_tbl: Lo que tenemos, campo a campo
es.f_es: Cuenta de garantía o protección del depósito
es.f_sat: Lectura por satélite (superficie construida, primera > última)
es.rec_n: Nuestra ficha: las fuentes están en la página del proyecto.
es.g_p: Para cada dato que falta: dónde puede confirmarlo una fuente oficial, o qué pedir por escrito al promotor.
es.g_all: Tenemos los 10 datos clave de este proyecto.
es.g_noreg: No hay registro oficial en línea para esto en nuestra lista de {m}.
es.ask_ho: Pida la fecha de entrega escrita en el contrato de compraventa y la penalización si se incumple.
es.ask_pn: Pida el número de licencia de obra o de registro del proyecto y compruébelo en la autoridad que lo emite.
es.ask_un: Pida el número total de viviendas de los planos aprobados.
es.ask_pr: Pida la lista de precios vigente, fechada y firmada.
es.ask_co: Pida el nombre legal y el número de registro de la sociedad que firma el contrato.
es.ask_es: Pregunte por escrito qué banco guarda los depósitos de los compradores y pida el número de cuenta o de aval.
es.ask_cp: Pida el último informe de obra firmado por la dirección facultativa, con su fecha.
es.ask_sat: Solo leemos imágenes Sentinel-2 de proyectos con una ubicación precisa en el mapa; indíquenos la parcela para añadirla.
es.ask_reg: Pida el extracto del registro (título, licencia o inscripción) y compruébelo en el propio registro.
es.ask_ct: Busque el nombre legal del promotor en la base pública de sentencias del tribunal; no tenemos ningún caso registrado.
es.m_p: Esta ficha tiene {k} de 10 campos. La ficha mediana en {m} tiene {md} de 10 ({n} proyectos).
es.meth: Método: los valores proceden de nuestro conjunto de datos publicado, la copia del registro del DLD, nuestro índice de obra Sentinel-2 y los casos judiciales que tenemos. La lista de registros es la de nuestra página de registros, cada uno consultado por nuestro comprobador. No es un veredicto sobre ningún proyecto ni promotor.
es.back: Volver a la página del proyecto
es.inj_p: La ficha campo a campo: {k} de 10 datos clave, cada uno con su fuente y fecha; {g} aún desconocidos, con cómo averiguarlos.
es.inj_m: Cómo se compara esta ficha con {m}, campo a campo
es.gp_h1: Dónde son más pobres nuestras fichas de proyectos
es.gp_lead: Para cada mercado con 10 o más proyectos: la proporción de fichas con cada uno de los 10 datos clave, y los registros oficiales que pueden completar lo que falta.
es.gp_reg_h: Registros oficiales que pueden completar lo que falta
es.gp_reg_p: De la lista de nuestra página de registros; nuestro comprobador consultó cada uno una vez.
es.gp_thin_h: Las fichas más pobres de los mayores mercados
es.gp_thin_p: Las cinco fichas con menos datos clave en cada uno de los 8 mayores mercados; cada una enlaza a su página campo a campo.
es.gp_link: Dónde son más pobres nuestras fichas, por mercado y campo
es.sh_p: Fichas de proyectos, campo a campo:
es.s1_s: los 10 datos clave de cada proyecto con el tipo de fuente (registro oficial, promotor, portal, nuestra lectura por satélite) y la fecha de lectura
es.s2_s: cada dato que falta con el registro oficial que puede confirmarlo en ese mercado, o qué pedir al promotor

es.yc_pb: Quien compra sobre plano en el extranjero paga señales por edificios que aún no existen, en un país cuyos registros, idioma y leyes no conoce. Las webs de los promotores son marketing; los datos que importan (licencia, sociedad, historial de la fecha de entrega, protección de las cantidades entregadas) están dispersos en registros oficiales.
es.yc_do: Para cada proyecto sobre plano que seguimos, una página pública con lo que promete el promotor, lo que muestran los registros oficiales y las fuentes independientes, y lo que no pudimos verificar, cada dato con su fuente y fecha. Quien quiere certeza paga una comprobación (desde 490 euros) o el seguimiento mensual de la obra (99 euros al mes). Los promotores nunca nos pagan.

es.dp_lead: Los compradores extranjeros no pueden distinguirle de los promotores que nunca construyen. Un Trust Score de Kolaboro verificado se lo permite.
es.dp_s1: Usted comparte el título del terreno, las licencias, el modelo de contrato y los documentos de la sociedad.
es.dp_s2: Los contrastamos con el registro oficial. Las visitas a obra de un agente local son a petición: confirmamos un agente local para su ubicación antes de que pague.
es.dp_s3: Ve los resultados y tiene 10 días laborables para responder o aportar pruebas.
es.dp_s4: La página de su proyecto se publica con su Trust Score y su respuesta.
es.dp_s5: Volvemos a comprobar cada 90 días mientras construye, para que su Score siga su avance.
es.dp_cost: Los promotores nunca pagan a Kolaboro. Los compradores financian cada comprobación. Por eso un buen resultado nuestro significa algo.
es.dp_bd: Si cada proyecto suyo que seguimos hace públicos los 6 controles del comprador (licencia, protección de las cantidades, avance, planos, historial, sin rentabilidad garantizada), puede mostrar un sello gratuito que enlaza a su página de promotor en Kolaboro. Se emite a partir de los datos públicos y no se puede comprar.

es.vf_st1: Leemos el dato donde se publica: un registro oficial, la web del propio promotor, un portal inmobiliario u otra página pública. Guardamos el valor tal como está escrito, con el enlace y la fecha de lectura.
es.vf_st2: Clasificamos el dato por su fuente, no por opinión. Un valor de un registro oficial o de nuestra lectura por satélite cuenta como confirmado. Un valor que solo publica el promotor, un portal u otra página cuenta como publicado, sin confirmar.
es.vf_st3: Un dato que no encontramos se queda vacío. Nunca lo estimamos: la ficha dice qué pedir al promotor y qué registro oficial puede confirmarlo.
es.vf_st4: Cada día guardamos una copia de cada ficha, encadenada con hashes SHA-256. Solo contamos un cambio cuando el valor se mueve, no cuando el mismo dato se reformula con más precisión.
es.vf_st5: Un dato leído hace más de 180 días se marca como "revisar de nuevo" en su ficha hasta que lo volvemos a leer.
es.vf_st6: Cualquiera puede avisar de un error y las correcciones se publican con su fecha. Son datos con su fuente, no un veredicto sobre ningún proyecto ni promotor.
es.vf_k_p: Cada dato lleva el tipo de su fuente. Solo los registros oficiales y nuestra lectura por satélite cuentan como confirmación.
